module: "donut" stunt zone type: the player must complete a full turn (360° accumulated velocity direction angle) while drifting inside a circle of radius scl around pos. The module returns a constructor called by gameplay_drift_stuntZones.setStuntZones; it is not an extension. On success, emits onAnyStuntZoneAccomplished with the sub-hook onDonutDriftAccomplished (donut base points).
notes: Leaving the circle resets the angle counter to 0 (isPlayerInside).
After success, the zone is unavailable for zoneData.cooldown seconds; the circle is drawn with colored segments (blue = turn completed, red/white = cooldown).
The number of circle segments is drawData.decalCount = scl * 10.

C.desc: Donut zone. Fields: data = {id, zoneData = {pos, scl (radius), cooldown}, drawData}, activeData = {isActive, currCooldown, totalDriftAngle, completedPerc}.

reset.desc: Resets activeData (cooldown to 0, accumulated angle to 0).

init.desc: Internal constructor: stores the zone data and calls reset().

accomplish.desc: Success: resets the accumulated angle to 0, starts the cooldown and emits onAnyStuntZoneAccomplished (sub-hook onDonutDriftAccomplished, points = donut base).

detectStunt.desc: Adds the frame's drift angle variation (gameplay_drift_drift.getAngleDiff) to the accumulated angle; at 360° or more, calls accomplish.

isAvailable.desc: Returns whether the cooldown has elapsed.

returns.desc: true if the zone can be validated.

isPlayerInside.desc: Tests whether the vehicle is within scl of pos; otherwise resets the accumulated angle to 0.

returns.desc: true if the player is inside the circle.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame by the manager: draws the circle.

sendDecals.desc: Draws the circle with debugDrawer:drawLineInstance, colored according to progress and cooldown (if drawing is enabled).
